name: Tata (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Tata: a crowned blue shield with a yellow fleur-de-lis, a patriarchal cross and a tower, above a scroll inscribed TATA.
history: The present flag of Tata has been in use since 1 January 2018, replacing the flag adopted in 1991. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tata arms with crown and scroll
